scope: Generated in-memory AC1027 DataStorage blob-page regression. Test-only change; no parser/writer change or on-disk drawing fixture.

generatedInput.storage: local std::vector<uint8_t>; no file read or write
generatedInput.payload: Authored ACIS BinaryFile marker plus a short textual body label; intentionally not a valid SAB.

positiveAssertions: section structurally valid and replay allowed
exact owner handle lookup and canonical handle key
two-page descriptor metadata and nonuniform page lengths
exact concatenated payload bytes and ACIS marker offset/length
physical segment ordering differs from logical page order
following ordinary record payload remains intact
malformedControls: second page start offset is noncontiguous
second page header count disagrees with descriptor
page reference points to a non-blob segment
test.malformedExpectedOutcome: Disable structural replay, omit the invalid blob record without partial payload, emit the blob-page structural diagnostic, and preserve the independent suffix record.
